opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C); up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics conferences: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences. Rolling scheme with bi-monthly deadlines (1st of Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short genetics-related training courses or collaborative visits to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques. Rolling scheme with quarterly deadlines (15th Feb, May, Aug, Nov).

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects, funded by income from the journal Heredity. Rolling scheme with quarterly deadlines (1st Feb, May, Aug, Nov).

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities can apply, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Support for members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, used as the awardee thinks best to support attendance. Rolling scheme; applied for prior to the meeting/event.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship levels vary: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session for up to about £1,000, or major sponsorship of several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorships between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members (undergraduate, graduate, junior postdocs, P/Co-Is) organising genetic-themed one-off meetings based in or with strong links to the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society. Members may apply at any time of the year, ideally at least three months in advance of the event.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members (undergraduate, graduate, junior postdocs, P/Co-Is) for public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs. Two deadlines per year (1 March and 1 October).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members (undergraduate, graduate, junior postdocs, P/Co-Is) running regular series of genetics research meetings based in or with strong links to the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings. Applications submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
